summary: Golub Capital Private Credit Fund filed a Form 8-K with two items: Regulation FD Disclosure (April 2026 distribution rates of $0.1875 per share for Class I and $0.1704 net for Class S, payable May 28, 2026) and Other Events (portfolio stats as of March 31, 2026: $9,928M fair value, 96% first-lien, 99% floating rate, leverage 1.25x, NAV $4,549M). This is a routine quarterly business update and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event is announced. The filing is purely operational and informational.
